# FDA's Concerns with Unapproved GLP-1 Drugs Used for Weight Loss
Compounded drugs are not FDA-approved. FDA does not review compounded versions of these drugs for safety, effectiveness, or quality before they are marketed.

## Dosing errors
FDA has received reports of adverse events, some requiring hospitalization, related to dosing errors with compounded semaglutide, including patients measuring the wrong amount from multi-dose vials.

## Shortage status
FDA has determined the shortages of semaglutide and tirzepatide injection products are resolved.
